title: Molecular orchestration enables mutually reinforcing electrolyte chemistry for lithium metal batteries exceeding 500 Wh kg−1
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE02570F, Paper
Yiming Zhang, Jiaxiang Zhao, Bosi Huang, Runhua Gao, Wenqiang Fang, Xinyu Luo, Kang Ma, Ming Yang, Jie Sun, Guangmin Zhou
